name: @phlix/syncplay
description: Framework-agnostic SyncPlay wire protocol + NTP time-sync for Phlix JS clients (mobile, windows, tizen). The single shared, canonical implementation of the SyncPlay protocol — the server is the source of truth. No framework deps; WebSocket and clock are injected.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly -p tsconfig.build.json

//engines: The published dist is dependency-free ES for browser + Node WebSocket consumers; this floor tracks the dev/test toolchain — vitest ^5 requires node ^22.12.0 || ^24.0.0 || >=26.0.0 and vite ^8 requires ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0, so 22.12.0 is their common floor (measured from the installed manifests, 2026-11-06).
author: detain
